name: atlas-platform
description: Atlas Automation — service-based media/broadcast automation platform. Nx monorepo: shared libraries under libs/, deployables under apps/, design docs under docs/.

scripts.verify: npm run lock:check && npm run format:check && npm run api:check && npm run tier0:check && npm run graph:check && npm run lint:scripts && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.k8s:build: docker build -f infra/docker/Dockerfile --build-arg SERVICE=iam -t atlas/iam:dev . && docker build -f infra/docker/Dockerfile --build-arg SERVICE=mam -t atlas/mam:dev . && docker build -f infra/docker/Dockerfile --build-arg SERVICE=websocket -t atlas/websocket:dev . && docker build -f infra/docker/Dockerfile --build-arg SERVICE=api-gateway -t atlas/api-gateway:dev . && docker build -f infra/docker/Dockerfile --build-arg SERVICE=logging -t atlas/logging:dev .
scripts.k8s:load: kind load docker-image atlas/iam:dev atlas/mam:dev atlas/websocket:dev atlas/api-gateway:dev atlas/logging:dev --name atlas-dev
scripts.k8s:up: npm run k8s:build && npm run k8s:load && npm run k8s:deploy
